papers.title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have achieved strong performance on a wide range of benchmarks, yet most evaluations assume static environments. In contrast, real-world deployment is inherently dynamic, requiring agents to continually align their knowledge, skills, and behavior with changing environments and updated task conditions. To address this gap, we introduce EvoArena, a benchmark suite that models environment changes as sequences of progressive updates across terminal, software, and so
papers.llm_reason: EvoArena 首次系统化评估 LLM Agent 在动态环境中的记忆演化能力，填补了现有 Agent 评估只关注静态场景的空白。环境变化建模为终端、软件、知识库的渐进更新序列，直接对应生产环境中 API 变更、依赖升级、文档更新等真实挑战。对 Agent 记忆管理和自适应性评估有直接工程价值。

papers.title: Agents-K1: Towards Agent-native Knowledge Orchestration
papers.abstract: Current LLM-based research agents have advanced through agent orchestration, yet largely overlook scientific knowledge orchestration. Existing works often reduce papers to abstracts, surface mentions, and flat \texttt{cites} edges, omitting key entities, claims, evidence, mechanisms, and method lineages essential for scientific reasoning. To this end, we introduce \textbf{Agents-K1}, an end-to-end knowledge orchestration pipeline that converts raw documents into agent-native scientific knowledge
papers.llm_reason: Agents-K1 提出端到端知识编排管线，将原始文档转换为 Agent-native 科学知识图谱，包含实体、声明、证据、机制和方法谱系。直接解决当前研究 Agent 将论文简化为摘要和扁平引用边的核心瓶颈。对构建自动化文献综述、科研助手、知识管理系统有即时工程价值。

papers.title: HyperTool: Beyond Step-Wise Tool Calls for Tool-Augmented Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents commonly rely on step-wise atomic tool calls, where each invocation, observation, and value transfer is exposed in the main reasoning trace. This creates an \emph{execution-granularity mismatch}: locally deterministic tool workflows are unfolded into repeated model-visible decisions, consuming context and forcing the model to manage low-level dataflow in the trace. We introduce \textbf{HyperTool}, a unified executable MCP-style tool interface that changes the model-visi
papers.llm_reason: HyperTool 提出 MCP 风格的统一可执行工具接口，解决 Agent 逐步工具调用中的执行粒度不匹配问题。将局部确定性的工具工作流从模型可见的推理轨迹中折叠，减少上下文消耗并释放模型的高层规划能力。对任何使用工具增强 Agent 的框架（LangChain、AutoGen、MCP 生态）有直接架构意义。

papers.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents have shown increasing potential in automating scientific discovery. Given an optimizable metric and an execution environment, they can propose, validate, and iterate scientific solutions, and have produced results that outperform human-designed approaches. As model capabilities continue to improve, we argue that the bottleneck for autonomous scientific discovery is shifting from prescribing agent workflows to designing agent environments: the resources, constraints, and interfac
papers.llm_reason: EurekAgent 将自主科学发现的瓶颈从 Agent 工作流设计重新定位为 Agent 环境设计，提出'环境工程'作为核心方法论。这一视角转变对 AI4Science 的工程实践有深远影响——当模型能力持续提升时，如何设计交互接口、资源约束和反馈机制成为关键。提出了新的研究范式但尚需广泛验证。

papers.title: SpatialClaw: Rethinking Action Interface for Agentic Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract: Spatial reasoning, the ability to determine where objects are, how they relate, and how they move in 3D, remains a fundamental challenge for vision-language models (VLMs). Tool-augmented agents attempt to address this by augmenting VLMs with specialist perception modules, yet their effectiveness is bounded by the action interface through which those tools are invoked. In this work, we study how the design of this interface shapes the agent's capacity for open-ended spatial reasoning. Existing sp
papers.llm_reason: SpatialClaw 重新审视工具增强 VLM Agent 的动作接口设计——接口如何塑造 Agent 的开放式空间推理能力。现有空间推理工具接口（离散标注 vs 连续查询）限制了 VLM 的三维理解。对多模态 Agent 的接口设计方法论有趋势价值，但摘要截断，具体新接口方案和评测结果需完整论文确认。

papers.title: Learning to Reason by Analogy via Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a standard mechanism for grounding language models in external knowledge, yet conventional retrieval based on lexical or semantic similarity is poorly suited for complex reasoning tasks: a semantically similar problem may demand an entirely different solution strategy, while a superficially different problem may share the same underlying reasoning pattern. We propose Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RA-RFT), a post-training framework
papers.llm_reason: RA-RFT 通过类比推理范式重新定义检索增强——不再基于语义相似性检索，而是基于推理结构的同构性检索。这一范式转变将 RAG 从'找相似文本'提升为'找相似推理模式'，对复杂数学推理、代码生成等需要深层类比的任务有重要价值。但工程复杂度较高，落地需要精细的推理结构提取。

papers.title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
papers.abstract: Articulated tool manipulation remains a major challenge in dexterous robotics due to the need to coordinate internal degrees of freedom and contact-rich interactions. While prior work has largely focused on rigid objects, articulated tool use remains underexplored because of its physical complexity and the difficulty of learning functional grasping and manipulation policies. papers.title: Automated reproducibility assessments in the social and behavioral sciences using large language models
papers.abstract: Reproducibility in the social and behavioral sciences is typically evaluated by independent researchers who reanalyze the original data to assess whether the published findings can be recovered. However, such approaches are resource-intensive and difficult to scale. Here, we show that large language models (LLMs) can automate reproducibility assessments. papers.title: Understanding Truncated Positional Encodings for Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Positional encodings (PEs) enhance the power of graph neural networks (GNNs), both theoretically and empirically. Two of the most popular families of PEs - spectral (e.g., Laplacian eigenspaces, effective resistance) and walk-based (polynomials of the adjacency matrix) - are theoretically equivalent in expressive power, with expressivity between the 1-WL and 3-WL tests. papers.title: Influcoder: Distilling Decoders' Gradient Influence Rankings into an Encoder for Data Attribution
papers.abstract: With the growth of LLMs' (Large Language Models) capabilities, there has been an increasing push to curate high quality datasets by filtering samples in the training data.
